propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits repeated 'Ambiguous prefix' errors for bare 4-hex commit-subject fragments that match multiple tickets, printing to stderr after the close has already committed durably.

The post-close _find_fixing_commit function hangs for minutes due to unbounded O(commits × tickets) alias scanning: per-commit re-resolution of the bug id without memoization or quiet mode, multiplied by thousands of commits each carrying distinct 4-hex subjects.
derive_caused_by must pass quiet=True at all four scanner call sites (_resolves_to twice, _commit_ticket, and self-comparison) and hoist loop-invariant bug_id resolution out of the per-commit loop.

A short-circuit guard on hex-quad shape (1-, 2-, 4-quad but not 3-quad forms) can only resolve to the target if the target's canonical id starts with it, eliminating filesystem work without changing any resolution outcomes.

Documentation currently advertises bare 4-digit references as a supported form in _ids.py module docstring and implicitly in AGENTS.md; this must be removed and replaced with canonical preferred forms (alias, 8-digit two-quad prefix, full id, Jira key).

Behavior of full id / 8-hex prefix / alias / Jira / unambiguous 4-hex resolution must remain unchanged; only quiet mode and memoization are added to eliminate noise and latency without changing what resolves.
